item.summary: fix(subagents): keep the failure cause on pending-error timeout announces (#125357) * fix(subagents): keep the failure cause on pending-error timeout announces A run that fails inside the lifecycle error retry grace window is handed to waiters as `status: "timeout"` with the failure text attached and `pendingError: true` (createPendingErrorTimeoutSnapshot). applySubagentWaitOutcome rebuilt that as a bare `{ status: "timeout" }`, dropping the cause, and the announce status label had no slot for it — so the parent agent was told only "timed out" for a child that had actually errored, and could neither retry appropriately nor report the real blocker. Two other consumers of the same wait result already treat this shape as a failure with a cause (isPendingErrorAgentWaitTimeout in sessions-send-tool, isDeliveryFailureWait in sessions-send-tool.a2a); the subagent announce path was the outlier. Keep the cause when `pendingError === true` and render it as "timed out: ". Genuine budget timeouts carry no pendingError and are unchanged. Tests: 3 unit cases for applySubagentWaitOutcome (pending-error timeout keeps the cause; budget timeout has none; wait error text without pendingError i
